'''Microweights''' were single-person ultra-light [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsor vehicles]]. Designed for the daring individual who liked to fly by the seat of their pants, microweights offered a discrete and delicate flying experience. [[Polymer/Legends|Polymer]] wings were coated with a sealer derived from the [[Cement/Legends|cementing]] fluids of the [[Bactriasan scarab]], which made the wings stronger than they appeared to be. Microweights were intended to be a recreational vehicle, but were often employed as emergency rescue vehicles.

One of the most popular microweights was the [[Hobbycraft Microweight]] produced by [[Illiseni Aerodyne]].
